Study Abroad Consultant (Travel Abroad) Job at DynamicPlus Advisory




        
    

        
        DynamicPlus Advisory is a professional consultancy that provides strategic and cost effective business solutions to start-ups as well as small and medium sized businesses by Studying their businesses, understanding their individual needs, and providing them with the necessary customized solutions to their Human Resources needs.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Study Abroad Consultant (Travel Abroad)

Job Location: Surulere, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Summary
     

            
    




	We are currently hiring a Student Counsellor to join our team in a Study Abroad/Education Consulting company.


Requirements


	HND or B.Sc. in any relevant field.
	1 - 2 years of relevant experience as a Student Counsellor.
	Must have experience in Schengen Visa processing and counselling.
	Good knowledge of study-abroad processes, visa applications and documentation.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to counsel students and guide them through the application process.
	Strong customer service and follow-up skills.
	Candidates must reside in Surulere, Lagos, or nearby areas.
	Must be organised, proactive and target-oriented.


Method of Applictaion 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

  "title": "Cybersecurity and Compliance Expert",
  "description": "SterlingPRO Business Application Limited is a leader in developing innovative fintech solutions that power the future of finance. We are a team of experts passionate about technology and driven by a mission to create seamless, secure, and inclusive financial experiences. We offer a dynamic and challenging environment where your work will have a direct impact on the security of millions of transactions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Cybersecurity and Compliance Expert

Job Location: Maryland (Mende), Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
Security Operations &amp; Incident Response:


	Lead security monitoring, threat detection, incident response, and SOC governance activities, ensuring 24/7 coverage for SterlingPRO&rsquo;s payment applications.
	Develop and optimise SIEM use cases, detection rules, alert management, and security monitoring processes tailored to financial transaction patterns.
	Manage MSSP and SOC providers, ensuring service quality, performance, and compliance with agreed SLAs.
	Develop and maintain incident response procedures and coordinate security exercises and tabletop testing activities, specifically simulating payment fraud and data breach scenarios.
	Support business continuity, disaster recovery planning, testing, and security governance activities to ensure the uninterrupted availability of SterlingPRO&rsquo;s POS, ATM, and Agency banking solutions.
	Identity, Cloud &amp; Data Security
	Manage identity security controls including MFA, Conditional Access, privileged access management (PAM), and identity risk monitoring to protect administrative access to core financial systems.
	Strengthen security across Azure/AWS environments, endpoints, collaboration platforms, and emerging technologies (including secure handling of biometric and payment data).
	Implement and oversee data classification, data protection, and access control frameworks to secure Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and financial data in transit and at rest.


Compliance &amp; Governance:


	Ensure compliance with client, contractual, and regulatory security requirements, including the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) guidelines, Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC) regulations, and other applicable laws.
	Understand fintech Structure and security architecture Requirements.
	Manage end-to-end compliance with PCI DSS standards, aligning with the latest PCI DSS v4.0 requirements, including continuous monitoring and risk-based security management.
	Interpret and implement global standards such as ISO 9564-1 for PIN management and EMVCo&#39;s security requirements for payment systems.
	Develop, review, and maintain security policies, standards, and procedures, ensuring they are technically enforceable and auditable.
	Lead audits and regulatory reviews, managing remediation activities and tracking compliance findings to closure.


Vulnerability &amp; Threat Management:


	Conduct technology risk assessments for all new and existing products.
	Establish a robust vulnerability management program, coordinating penetration testing and overseeing the remediation of identified weaknesses.
	Manage the vendor risk management process, conducting thorough security assessments of third-party vendors and partners.
	Monitor security events using SIEM platforms, leading incident response, threat hunting, and digital forensics activities.
	Champion operational resilience, ensuring the organization can maintain critical functions during and after a security incident.


DevSecOps&amp;Third-Party Security:


	Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, SCA), working directly with engineering teams to promote secure coding practices.
	Manage supplier security assessments and third-party risk assurance activities for vendors supporting our payment ecosystem.


Education&amp; Certifications:


	Educational Background: Bachelor&rsquo;s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology,a related field; or equivalent proven experience. A Master&rsquo;s degree or MBA is a plus.
	Certifications: One or more of the following is highly preferred: CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor.
	Standards: Expert knowledge of PCI DSS, ISO 27001, NIST, and OWASP.


Professional Experience


	5+ years of experience leading security operations within a hybrid SOC environment (Fintech industry experience is an advantage)
	Track record of successfully managing regulatory relationships and navigating complex compliance landscapes (CBN, NDPC).
	Strong knowledge of SIEM platforms, particularly Microsoft Sentinel or equivalent technologies (e.g., Splunk, QRadar).
	Expertise in threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, and security monitoring.
	Hands-on experience with modern security tooling: EDR/XDR (e.g., Microsoft Defender), IAM (Entra ID), Cloud Security (Azure/AWS native tools), and Data Loss Prevention technologies.
	Strong understanding of Zero Trust architecture, identity security, cloud security, and DevSecOps principles.
	Working knowledge of ISO 27001, SOC 2, risk management frameworks, and audit processes.
	Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, senior stakeholders, clients, and external partners.


Salary
N400,000 Monthly.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: hr@sterlingprong.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

We are a team of experts passionate about technology and driven by a mission to create seamless, secure, and inclusive financial experiences. We offer a dynamic and challenging environment where your work will have a direct impact on the security of millions of transactions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Cybersecurity and Compliance Expert

Job Location: Maryland (Mende), Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
Security Operations & Incident Response:
     

            
    




	Lead security monitoring, threat detection, incident response, and SOC governance activities, ensuring 24/7 coverage for SterlingPRO’s payment applications.
	Develop and optimise SIEM use cases, detection rules, alert management, and security monitoring processes tailored to financial transaction patterns.
	Manage MSSP and SOC providers, ensuring service quality, performance, and compliance with agreed SLAs.
	Develop and maintain incident response procedures and coordinate security exercises and tabletop testing activities, specifically simulating payment fraud and data breach scenarios.
	Support business continuity, disaster recovery planning, testing, and security governance activities to ensure the uninterrupted availability of SterlingPRO’s POS, ATM, and Agency banking solutions.
	Identity, Cloud & Data Security
	Manage identity security controls including MFA, Conditional Access, privileged access management (PAM), and identity risk monitoring to protect administrative access to core financial systems.
	Strengthen security across Azure/AWS environments, endpoints, collaboration platforms, and emerging technologies (including secure handling of biometric and payment data).
	Implement and oversee data classification, data protection, and access control frameworks to secure Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and financial data in transit and at rest.


Compliance & Governance:


	Ensure compliance with client, contractual, and regulatory security requirements, including the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) guidelines, Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC) regulations, and other applicable laws.
	Understand fintech Structure and security architecture Requirements.
	Manage end-to-end compliance with PCI DSS standards, aligning with the latest PCI DSS v4.0 requirements, including continuous monitoring and risk-based security management.
	Interpret and implement global standards such as ISO 9564-1 for PIN management and EMVCo's security requirements for payment systems.
	Develop, review, and maintain security policies, standards, and procedures, ensuring they are technically enforceable and auditable.
	Lead audits and regulatory reviews, managing remediation activities and tracking compliance findings to closure.


Vulnerability & Threat Management:


	Conduct technology risk assessments for all new and existing products.
	Establish a robust vulnerability management program, coordinating penetration testing and overseeing the remediation of identified weaknesses.
	Manage the vendor risk management process, conducting thorough security assessments of third-party vendors and partners.
	Monitor security events using SIEM platforms, leading incident response, threat hunting, and digital forensics activities.
	Champion operational resilience, ensuring the organization can maintain critical functions during and after a security incident.


DevSecOps&Third-Party Security:


	Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, SCA), working directly with engineering teams to promote secure coding practices.
	Manage supplier security assessments and third-party risk assurance activities for vendors supporting our payment ecosystem.


Education& Certifications:


	Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology,a related field; or equivalent proven experience. A Master’s degree or MBA is a plus.
	Certifications: One or more of the following is highly preferred: CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor.
	Standards: Expert knowledge of PCI DSS, ISO 27001, NIST, and OWASP.


Professional Experience


	5+ years of experience leading security operations within a hybrid SOC environment (Fintech industry experience is an advantage)
	Track record of successfully managing regulatory relationships and navigating complex compliance landscapes (CBN, NDPC).
	Strong knowledge of SIEM platforms, particularly Microsoft Sentinel or equivalent technologies (e.g., Splunk, QRadar).
	Expertise in threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, and security monitoring.
	Hands-on experience with modern security tooling: EDR/XDR (e.g., Microsoft Defender), IAM (Entra ID), Cloud Security (Azure/AWS native tools), and Data Loss Prevention technologies.
	Strong understanding of Zero Trust architecture, identity security, cloud security, and DevSecOps principles.
	Working knowledge of ISO 27001, SOC 2, risk management frameworks, and audit processes.
	Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, senior stakeholders, clients, and external partners.


Salary
N400,000 Monthly.

About the Role


	SterlingPRO Business Application is looking for a talented UI/UX Designer to join our [Product / Design] team.
	You will be responsible for the end-to-end design of our digital products, from conducting user research to shipping pixel-perfect interfaces. You will work closely with Product Managers and Engineers to turn complex problems into intuitive, accessible, and beautiful experiences for our users.


Key Responsibilities
User Research &amp; Strategy:


	Conduct user research, interviews, and usability testing to understand user needs and pain points.
	Create user personas, journey maps, and information architecture to guide design decisions.
	Analyze user data and feedback to iterate on existing features and improve conversion rates.


UX Design (The &quot;Thinker&quot;):


	Create wireframes, user flows, and low-fidelity prototypes to communicate interaction concepts.
	Design end-to-end user journeys that solve specific problems while aligning with business goals.
	Conduct usability testing sessions and synthesize feedback into actionable design changes.


UI Design (The &quot;Maker&quot;):


	Create high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes using tools like [Figma / Sketch / Adobe XD] .
	Develop and maintain a scalable design system and component library to ensure consistency across all platforms.
	Ensure the final designs are visually stunning, on-brand, and responsive across mobile and web.


Collaboration &amp; Handoff:


	Work closely with Product Managers to define project scope and requirements.
	Collaborate with Engineers to ensure design integrity is maintained during implementation (QA).
	Present design concepts and rationale to stakeholders clearly and effectively.


Requirements &amp; Qualifications
Must-Haves:


	At least 3 years of experience in UI/UX design (portfolio required).
	A strong portfolio demonstrating a deep understanding of both UX process (flows, wireframes) and UI execution (visual polish, typography).
	Proficiency in design tools: [e.g., Figma, Principle, ProtoPie].
	Experience working with design systems and component libraries.
	Solid understanding of responsive design, accessibility (WCAG), and platform guidelines (iOS/Android/Web).
	Ability to work in an agile, fast-paced environment.


Nice-to-Haves (Bonus):


	Basic understanding of HTML/CSS (to communicate effectively with devs).
	Experience with motion design or micro-interactions.
	Experience in Fintech/Payments is an added advantage.


What We Offer


	Competitive salary.
	Health Insurance and Pension.
	A collaborative, diverse, and inclusive culture.

Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: hr@sterlingprong.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note


	Please ensure your CV highlights relevant experince and qualifications.
	Submissions should be made promptly to facilitate timely review.

Customer Service Officer / Social Media Executive Job at DynamicPlus Advisory




        
    

        
        DynamicPlus Advisory is a professional consultancy that provides strategic and cost effective business solutions to start-ups as well as small and medium sized businesses by Studying their businesses, understanding their individual needs, and providing them with the necessary customized solutions to their Human Resources needs.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Service Officer / Social Media Executive

Job Location: Lekki / Ajah, Lagos 
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Attend to customer enquiries via phone, WhatsApp, and social media.
	Manage and respond to social media messages and comments.
	Assist with creating and posting engaging social media content.
	Maintain good relationships with customers.
	Support the team with day-to-day administrative and customer service activities.


Requirements


	Fresh graduates and serving Corps Members are encouraged to apply.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Must be customer-focused, friendly, and professional.
	Basic knowledge of social media platforms and content management.
	Ability to respond to customer enquiries promptly.
	Computer literacy is an added advantage.
	Candidates residing around Lekki, Ajah, Sangotedo, or nearby areas are preferred.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
